front.title: PASSporT Device Information Extension for Enhanced Caller Authentication and Fraud Resilience

abstract.t:
This document defines a PASSporT extension and a new claim, "dinfo", for carrying authenticated, privacy-minimized information about the endpoint associated with the origination of a call. The claim conveys coarse-grained device characteristics and an optional, non- correlatable device reference.
The information is intended for use as an additional input to fraud analysis, policy enforcement, and operational diagnostics. It is not an assertion that the endpoint, caller, or call is trustworthy. This document specifies claim syntax, creation and verification procedures, privacy requirements, and IANA registrations.
